canonicalTitle: Distance-9 surface code logical qubit demonstrates sustained below-threshold operation across one million cycles
reason: arXiv preprint from the Fenwick Quantum group demonstrating a distance-9 surface code logical qubit holding a 1.1e-7 logical error rate across 1M cycles, the first published run below threshold for that duration. Primary is the preprint itm-0001.

canonicalTitle: BIS issues interim final rule expanding export controls to mid-tier AI accelerators via performance-density threshold
reason: BIS interim final rule extending licence requirements to mid-tier accelerators above a revised performance-density threshold, taking effect in 30 days without general licence for existing orders. Primary is the official BIS announcement itm-0010.

canonicalTitle: Quarrystone releases security patches 17.4 and 16.8 fixing unauthenticated WAL exposure flaw CVE-2026-41882
reason: Quarrystone official security release addressing CVE-2026-41882, which allows unauthenticated logical replication slot creation and full write-ahead log access when scram channel binding is disabled. Primary is the official newsroom announcement itm-0004.

canonicalTitle: Northbridge us-east-2 control plane disruption blocks instance launches and scaling for six hours
reason: A failed certificate rotation in Northbridge us-east-2 control plane froze all launches, autoscaling, and ELB modifications for 6h11m while running instances remained unaffected. Primary is the official announcement itm-0021 and status repository itm-0009.

canonicalTitle: US initial jobless claims hold steady at 214,000 for week ending September 10, 2026
reason: Routine scheduled Department of Labor economic release via FRED showing initial claims at 214,000, 4-week average at 216,500. Consistent with unchanged labor market. Primary is official FRED release itm-0012.

reason: Routine scheduled Department of Labor economic release via FRED showing initial claims at 214,000, 4-week average at 216,500. Stable slug without date.

canonicalTitle: Reports emerge of unannounced Meridian model with two-million-token context window
reason: The Information reports that three people with knowledge of the roadmap describe an unreleased Meridian model with a 2M-token context window and retrieval-free long-document mode. Meridian Labs has declined to comment. Primary is The Information itm-0067.

canonicalTitle: Vantiq Systems cuts full-year revenue guidance by 9% citing enterprise renewal slippage
reason: Vantiq Systems 8-K filing cuts full-year revenue guidance by 9%, citing slippage in multi-year enterprise renewals rather than churn; net revenue retention dropped from 112% to 104%. Primary is official SEC EDGAR 8-K itm-0064.

canonicalTitle: Aperture Research releases Nimbus-7 72B MoE weights with commercial serving restrictions
reason: Aperture published weights for Nimbus-7 72B MoE model (8 active experts) with a licence permitting research and internal use but expressly forbidding third-party model serving. Primaries are official announcement itm-0069 and repo itm-0075.

canonicalTitle: Rust 1.94 released with parallel front end enabled by default
reason: Official release of Rust 1.94 enabling parallel compiler frontend by default (22% median reduction in cold check times) and stabilising 3 const APIs. Primaries are official release announcement itm-0072 and rust-lang/rust PR itm-0071.

canonicalTitle: Ashgrove Utilities declares quarterly dividend of 0.42 dollars per share
reason: Ashgrove Utilities 8-K filing declaring routine quarterly dividend of $0.42 per share. Primary is official EDGAR 8-K itm-0030.

canonicalTitle: Linux 6.19 merges deadline-aware fair scheduler rework
reason: Linux 6.19 merge window incorporates deadline-aware fair scheduler rework replacing vruntime heuristic for latency-sensitive tasks with explicit per-task deadlines. Primary is git commit/merge itm-0063.

canonicalTitle: Sable ORM 6.2.0 bug causes silent row loss during batched upserts
reason: Bug report on sable-orm 6.2.0 with a 40-line reproducible test case against PostgreSQL 17 reveals that batched upserts silently discard rows when the batch size exceeds the connection pool size. Primary is GitHub issue itm-0079.

canonicalTitle: Financial Stability Board mandates daily reserve attestation and 80% overnight holdings for major stablecoin issuers
reason: Financial Stability Board final rule requiring payment stablecoin issuers above $10B in circulation to publish daily third-party attested reserve compositions and hold at least 80% in overnight instruments, with a 180-day compliance window. Primary is official FSB release itm-0043.

canonicalTitle: Study finds rack-level power capping causes 11% accelerator idle time in production clusters
reason: arXiv preprint from Ridgeway University measuring 4 production clusters, finding accelerators idle 11% of wall-clock time due to rack-level power capping rather than scheduler bottlenecks. Primary is arXiv paper itm-0042.

canonicalTitle: Anvil Data Centres defers two campus builds citing substation energisation delays to 2029
reason: Anvil Data Centres investor disclosure deferring two campus builds due to local utility substation interconnection queue delays extending to 2029. Primary is Datacenter Dynamics reporting itm-0055.
